method: Visual inspection of original native XCTest screen captures. No transformed pixels or assertion-only visual credit.

captures.observation: Compact native empty-agenda GroupBox and its entire description are visible above the system bottom tabs at the initial month position.
Plain native Item row has a distinct blue checked circle, struck-through title and separate navigation disclosure. No oversized rounded row card.
Landscape phone keeps native bottom tabs and readable selected notes. The scrolling Form continues beneath the translucent bar; full large-text/scroll acceptance is not established.
Shared sidebar no longer repeats Planner below the toolbar; the collection uses plain selected rows while details remain grouped. All three panes are readable in dark landscape.

Local Done row, native progress, notes and contextual details remain visible. The populated List title still inherits secondary Section-header styling; this observation prompted the explicit Color.primary correction.
Expanded rich draft retains readable dark grouped controls, labels, owned address and link fields. Origin heading remains visible in the adjoining content pane.
Native mobile month selection and compact empty-agenda card are readable in dark mode beside the shared sidebar.

Explicit Color.primary restores the populated List title to black in light mode. The orange missing-estimate message is low contrast here, prompting the subsequent primary-text/orange-icon correction.
Final light List heading and warning message use readable primary text; the warning symbol remains orange. Native progress, selected local row and grouped details remain clear.
Final dark Item catalog uses readable plain rows, explicit checked state and completed-title strike-through beside native bottom tabs.
Final dark month agenda keeps its compact card and full guidance above the bottom tabs.

Native dark New Item Form uses readable semantic surfaces and controls. Location extends beneath the translucent tab bar in this initial scroll position; large-text/complete scroll acceptance remains open.

limits: Only named original captures have visual credit. Earlier tablet epochs precede final color corrections. Mac runtime, physical devices and full accessibility/scene-state acceptance remain open.
